description:
Set or update the one-time sale price for an existing strategy. Set to 0 to disable one-time purchase (subscription only). The sale allows users to permanently own the strategy with a single payment.

Platform fee: TradeAssi keeps 15% of every sale; you receive 85%, paid in USDC on Base (min $10). Nothing is listed until the forward test passes. Call get_marketplace_terms for details.

sale_price.description: One-time purchase price in USD (0 = disable sale, subscription only)

name: set_strategy_sale_price
title: Set Strategy Sale Price
